question: does the harness itself queue a message written while a turn is in flight, and dequeue it in order?
answer: YES. The message was accepted while busy, held by the harness, and run as the next turn in order.
what_the_screen_shows_while_queued: The composer returns to its empty placeholder '› Ask Codex to do anything' and the queued message is shown as a '↳ <text>' row directly above the composer. It is NOT echoed as a '› <text>' transcript line until it is dequeued, so '↳' vs '›' is what distinguishes queued from sent on this harness.

measured.interpolation_method: direct: per-read timestamps in the capture (reads.jsonl of the run), no interpolation

01_turn1_in_flight.note: turn 1 busy ('Working (3s • esc to interrupt)'), composer at its empty placeholder

02_second_message_typed.note: second message sitting in the composer while turn 1 is in flight, before its Enter

03_queued.note: 1.0 s after the second Enter: message accepted and QUEUED

04_still_queued.note: 41 s after the second Enter, turn 1 still in flight, message still queued

05_dequeued_running.note: turn 1 finished and the queued message is now the running turn

06_second_answer.note: the queued message has been answered
